verdict.rationale: Kitty's remote control lets scripts open windows, send text to any window and change window and tab titles (kitty-docs-23). A hands-on probe confirmed `kitten @ ls` returns the full window, tab and layout state as JSON, with send-text, get-text and close-window working (kitty-probe-rt-1). An agent could therefore enumerate all windows and loop over them, but the evidence never shows a native multi-target or batch operation, so bulk action is only inferred from per-window scripting. Missing for 10: documented multi-window match/broadcast targeting, hands-on evidence of one command acting on many windows or tabs, and independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
